notes: The core paid-sick-leave statute: accrual of sick days, the percentage of wage payable per day of absence, and proof of illness. CAUTION for a human: Israel splits sick-leave-type entitlements across several short Acts, and absences for a family member are in SEPARATE statutes (notably חוק דמי מחלה (היעדרות בשל מחלת ילד) and its siblings for a spouse or parent), which are not included here. Do not assume this Act alone states the whole paid-absence regime.
